newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NSW Grains Board names general manager marketing.
newsitem.headline: NSW Grains Board names general manager marketing.

text.p: The New South Wales Grains Board said it appointed Ian Macintosh as general manager marketing following the resignation of Robert Thompson from the position.
NSW Grains Board managing director Graham Lawrence said the board had reviewed its marketing operations following 50 percent average annual growth over the past five years.
Macintosh recently joined the board from the international trading house Nadera/Concordia and, since joining, has been managing the feed grains desk, Lawrence said in a statement.
Macintosh will manage domestic grain accumulation and Australian and export marketing of all the board's grains, oilseeds and pulses.
